items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Jack was her old man. They had a fight in China... Valaida had shot at Jack Carter.

ctx.x: Yes. She was everything. She was a master showman. She directed the band; she directed Blackbirds. She got up on the stage and did her thing. She was a star, almost a superstar. For nothing but personality. I was with her one time... Jack was her old man. They had a fight in China, a mix-up. She got to the pistol...
